Ramayana film trailer released, sparking online discussion

The trailer for the upcoming film 'Ramayana: Part 1' has been released, showcasing key characters and plot highlights. The four-minute trailer introduces multiple characters, including Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Ram, Sai Pallavi as Sita, and Yash as Ravana. The release has generated significant online discussion, with audiences dissecting details such as Sita's portrayal with a sword and the introduction of various mythological elements. Ranbir Kapoor has also addressed criticism regarding casting choices for the role of Lord Ram.
